verdict.rationale: Evidence item cactus-compute-docs-10 is drawn from a live OpenAPI document at https://cactuscompute.com/v1/openapi.json, whose description covers the tool-calling data generation, fine-tuning and model download API, so a machine-readable spec is downloadable. The probe's 404s were only at non-/v1 paths and do not contradict this. missing for 10: first-party docs that point users to the spec or explain how to download it, confirmation that the spec fully covers the documented endpoints (/generations, /tool_schemas, /billing, uploads), and independent hands-on corroboration that it is usable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Generate tool-calling training data, fine-tune Needle 3, and download the resulting models.
